prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one production-quality hospital homepage hero background, a highly polished photorealistic 3D illusion render. Requested output 3840 x 1800 pixels, 32:15 ultra-wide landscape. No text, letters, labels, logos, watermark, border, UI, people or real hospital facade. Composition is essential: the entire LEFT 52% is quiet warm ivory negative space for live website headings. Main sculpture occupies x=60–92%, y=20–72%; no important details near outer edges or top 18% or bottom 20%. Elegant seamless warm ivory studio stage with a soft curved architectural alcove on the RIGHT, perspective depth, sculptural pedestal, deliberate negative space. Directional sunlight from upper left, realistic ambient occlusion, crisp contact shadows, subtle caustics, tactile material detail and physically accurate reflections. Strong optical depth and rounded forms appearing to project out of the screen. Sharp premium luxury medical advertising, restrained not cluttered, no fog, no blur, no noise, no flat vector illustration, no toy/cartoon appearance. Campaign 1: comprehensive compassionate hospital care. A large sculptural medical plus sign in frosted ivory glass with translucent warm orange side walls, a realistically detailed silver and teal stethoscope gracefully draped over its base, one elegant translucent orange glass orbit ribbon curving in front of and behind it. A pale ice-blue recessed architectural ring behind the cross enhances perspective. Sculptural cross at x76% y44%. Distinct foreground and background separation with carefully cast long soft shadows. Cream, muted hospital orange, clear ice blue, polished brushed steel.
